notes: %KS / %KS_CALCULATION (weighted, ranked KS lift-table macro) is byte-identical to the source macro definitions except: (1) 'group=&bin.' -> 'groups=&bin.' on the PROC RANK call - the source's 'group=' is not a documented PROC RANK option (GROUPS= is), so this looks like the author's own typo rather than a Jenner gap; (2) one PROC SQL SELECT column-item's 'Total_bin Format=Comma20.0 as Total' was reordered to 'Total_bin as Total Format=Comma20.0' - Jenner 0.1.0 does not accept FORMAT= preceding AS in a SELECT column-item (filed upstream as a regression test in set/, pending confirmation of correct SAS token order). The source file only defines these macros (its own sample call is commented out), so this bundle adds a mock scored dataset (GBI_Tag 0/1 flag, Reverse_scale_Score, wgt) and calls %KS the way the source file's own header comment documents. Note: Jenner 0.1.0 has a separate confirmed bug where 'retain var1 var2 var3 0;' (multiple variables sharing one trailing initial value) only initializes the variable immediately adjacent to the value, leaving earlier-listed variables permanently missing - this makes the macro's cum_pct_bad/cum_pct_good/KS columns show as missing in the captured output below. That is genuine, reproducible Jenner behavior (also filed upstream), not a bundle authoring error, so it is captured as-is rather than worked around.
